description: SYSDATE() in every position: projection, INSERT, WHERE, comparisons vs fixed past timestamps, subqueries, CTAS. Converted 1:1 from functions/SysdateTest.java (now retired); not-null / type asserts on the non-deterministic value became SQL IS NOT NULL checks.

steps.sql: SELECT SYSDATE() IS NOT NULL AS current_time_present
SELECT SYSDATE() AS ts
CREATE TABLE audit_log (id INTEGER, created_at TIMESTAMP_NTZ)
INSERT INTO audit_log VALUES (1, SYSDATE())
SELECT created_at IS NOT NULL FROM audit_log WHERE id = 1
CREATE TABLE events (id INTEGER, event_time TIMESTAMP_NTZ)
INSERT INTO events VALUES (1, TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ('2020-01-01 00:00:00'))
INSERT INTO events VALUES (2, DATEADD(second, -1, SYSDATE()))
SELECT id FROM events WHERE event_time < SYSDATE() ORDER BY id
SELECT SYSDATE() > TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ('2020-01-01 00:00:00') AS is_after
SELECT SYSDATE() IS NOT NULL AS ts1, SYSDATE() IS NOT NULL AS ts2
CREATE TABLE logs (id INTEGER, log_time TIMESTAMP_NTZ)
INSERT INTO logs (id, log_time) VALUES (1, SYSDATE())
INSERT INTO logs (id, log_time) VALUES (2, SYSDATE())
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM logs WHERE log_time IS NOT NULL
CREATE TABLE task_list (id INTEGER, due_date TIMESTAMP_NTZ)
INSERT INTO task_list VALUES (1, SYSDATE())
SELECT id FROM task_list WHERE due_date <= SYSDATE()
CREATE TABLE orders (id INTEGER, order_date TIMESTAMP_NTZ)
INSERT INTO orders VALUES (1, TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ('2024-01-01 10:00:00'))
INSERT INTO orders VALUES (2, TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ('2024-06-01 10:00:00'))
SELECT id FROM orders WHERE order_date < (SELECT SYSDATE()) ORDER BY id
CREATE TABLE snapshot AS SELECT 1 AS id, SYSDATE() AS snapshot_time
SELECT snapshot_time IS NOT NULL FROM snapshot
